The reason is that the growth of the mind is not the kind of thing that can be portrayed by a game. You can’t show growth in the way you can show, for example, the act of throwing a basketball through a hoop.

Games are about a very narrow kind of growth. They are about mechanical growth, or the growth of the skill that the player possesses. Growth is a consequence of the act of playing a game, and it is only about the game, not about the player’s mind.

On the other hand, my game is not really about mechanical growth at all. It’s about the mind. A game about the mind cannot be about mechanical growth, because it cannot be played in a mechanical way.

You have to notice when your attention wanders, and you have to be aware of what your attention is. You have to watch the growth of your mind, and you have to be open to that growth.
